name: x4_refs
method: Batch-1 decode and prefill at fixed contexts, for the expert-offload comparisons (docs/dev/v1-offload.md acceptance 3, D14): every arm loads in a fresh process, runs one untimed warm-up request, then for each context C one request of a C-token prompt generating 256 tokens, greedy, ignore_eos. Prefill tok/s = C / prompt time; decode tok/s = (tokens - 1) / (last token - first token). Prompts are spans of natural text (the judge prompt set's token ids, concatenated and cut at fixed, distinct offsets, wrapping), the same ids for every engine and round, so an expert cache sees real routing and no prefix cache can reuse one prompt for another.
